title: Pablo Exclusive Lemonade Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Exclusive Lemonade Nicotine Pouches offer a vibrant citrus experience for those who demand intensity. The flavour profile mirrors the taste of fresh, cloudy lemonade—combining zesty tartness with a sweet, satisfying finish. Part of the high-strength Exclusive collection, these pouches are crafted for the experienced user. The slim, tobacco-free format sits comfortably against the gum, delivering a rapid 30mg/g nicotine release that is both powerful and discreet. Perfect for moments when you need a strong, reliable hit without compromising on refreshing flavour. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
